digest.component_or_area: LLM agent tool execution and cutoff mechanism
propositions: When tool_step_limit is reached after a tool call has occurred, the current implementation hides tools from the request while the message history contains toolUse blocks, violating Bedrock Converse and Anthropic provider constraints that toolConfig must be defined whenever toolUse/tool_use history is present, resulting in 400 ValidationException.
The current empty-filter cutoff mechanism converts provider protocol violations into LLMUnavailableError sweeps instead of gracefully landing the run.
Tool definitions must remain advertised throughout the entire run after any tool call has occurred to maintain provider protocol validity.

The steering wrapper approach replaces tool execution with a fixed advisory notice once run_step exceeds the limit, allowing the model to land naturally through the existing output path without removing the tool surface.
The existing UsageLimits budget (request_limit and tool_calls_limit) remains as a terminal backstop for non-cooperative models that ignore steering and keep issuing tool calls.
